thread:
Tara (product): Rolling out Privileged Session Recorder (beta) for Private/VPC customers in v4.0.0 today. Opt-in feature: captures operator session transcripts (command streams, timestamps, metadata), stores encrypted artifacts locally, and produces a redaction-friendly export for audits.

Tara (product): Why: customers asked for verifiable operator activity records that never leave their VPC. This is different from lightweight session metadata 30s logsits full session capture with configurable retention and redaction.

DeployBot: Rollout started: v4.0.0-session-recorder -> canary us-east-1 at 3945678965

Kei (eng): Tech note: recorder streams keystrokes/commands, terminal output, and timing to a local write-ahead encrypted log. Bundles are chunked, signed, and stored under customer-managed encryption keys (KMS/HSM supported). We expose metrics: recorder.capture.rate, bundle.encrypt.latency.

Owen (security): Compliance note: retention and redaction policies are configurable per-tenant. For SOC2/PCI customers we recommend HSM-backed keys and enabling session attestations. Recorder supports redaction rules and a strict-access verifier for auditors.

Tara (product): Opt-in UX: Console toggle + `redwoodctl sessions enable-recorder --dry-run`. Dry-run emits a sample redacted bundle you can verify without storing real content. No automatic opt-in.

Kei (eng): CLI snippets for KB:
```
# dry-run to preview redaction
redwoodctl sessions enable-recorder --mode capture --redaction basic --dry-run

# enable, set retention 180d, use KMS key
redwoodctl sessions set --enabled true --retention 180d --kms-key arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd

# export and verify recorded bundle
redwoodctl sessions export --id 2026-07-01 --out session-2026-07-01.tar.gz
redwoodctl sessions verify --file session-2026-07-01.tar.gz
```

Ravi (docs): I'll draft KB: overview, redaction examples, auditor verifier script, and migration notes. Need final CLI snippets and sample redaction rules.

Owen (security): Add guidance about encrypting at rest, key rotation cadence (90d default), and how to show auditors the verification workflow without exposing secrets. Also include legal consideration blurb for session recording in regions with consent laws.

Mira (sales): Sales want a 2-line blurb for customers who ask about privacy and risk: any suggestions?

Tara (product): Two-liner: "Privileged Session Recorder gives you verifiable, on-prem session artifacts for operator activity. Configurable redaction and local encryption keep sensitive data inside your VPC; opt-in with a dry-run preview."

Kei (eng): Fallback behaviour: recorder runs asynchronously; if capture fails we emit a non-blocking alert and continue operations. Critical failures trigger Console alert and optional fail-closed mode which blocks new operator sessions until resolved (customer-configurable). All failures logged into the audit bundle.

DeployBot: Canary complete at 3945679200, monitoring window 1h.

Ravi (docs): I'll include the redaction rule examples and the dry-run output in the KB draft. PR incoming in #docs in 2 hours.

Mira (sales): I'll start pilot outreach to existing compliance customers after KB lands.

Tara (product): Action items: Tara publish announcement + compliance blurb; Kei run staging + verify fail-closed mode; Owen add consent/legal notes and HSM guidance; Ravi KB + verifier script; Mira pilot outreach. Please react with :thumbsup: when your item is complete.
